tools.name: get_reference
tools.description: Use this when you need today's date in Argentina, the latest draw day, the list of quinielas (the 12 jurisdictions, which turnos each plays) or the turno schedule ('¿a qué hora es la nocturna?', '¿qué quinielas hay?'). Returns reference data only, no results.

tools.name: get_cabezas
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what came out in the Argentine quiniela on a day: '¿qué salió hoy?', 'quiniela de hoy', 'cabezas de ayer', 'resultados de la quiniela', 'quiniela nacional/provincia hoy'. tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Use this when the user wants the full results (the pizarra: 20 numbers) of a quiniela or a turno: 'pizarra de la nocturna', 'los 20 números de la Provincia', 'quiniela de Córdoba vespertina de ayer'. Returns all 20 positions, the cabeza, the draw number and the letters. Filter by jurisdiction (ciuda

tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether a number came out: '¿salió el 23?', '¿salió el 4512 a la cabeza?', 'controlar quiniela'. tools.description: Use this when the user asks what a number means in the quiniela or which number a dream corresponds to: '¿qué significa el 48?', 'el 23 en la quiniela', 'soñé con un perro'. tools.description: Use this when the user asks for the history of past results: 'números más salidos', 'números más atrasados', 'qué número salió más en la Provincia'. Returns how often each ending (00-99) came out a la cabeza, overall and in the last 90 days, and the ones absent the longest. Descriptive history only:

tools.name: get_telekino
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about Telekino or Rekino: 'telekino de hoy', 'último sorteo del telekino', 'telekino 2449'. Returns the winning numbers, the winners and prize amounts per hit level, and the winning cartons of the latest sorteo or a given one.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Quiniela Hoy results with a natural-language query in Spanish or English (e.g. 'quiniela nocturna de ayer', 'Córdoba 2026-10-03', 'qué significa el 23', 'telekino'). Returns document ids to pass to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns the full content of a document id returned by search.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
